page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Continuous commentary paragraphs, then a chapter heading "CAPUT XLV." and the opening paragraph of the chapter with a large initial. Catchword "non" at lower right.

main_text.p: Domini annūcio, eadem ipse perficiet. Ac proinde cum nunc dixerit de Ierusalem, quòd inhabitabitur, sine dubio id fiet: cum dixerit de ciuitatibus Iuda, quòd re-ædificabuntur, sine dubio reædificabuntur.

Ipse dicit de Chorefch.)Ad maiorem certitudinem eorum quæ hactenus dicta sunt, & ad confutandum uanos diuinatores, nunc etiam nomen eius exprimit, per quem ex captiuitate Babylonica liberabitur. Hebræis Chorefch Cyrus est, Rex Persarum, quem etiam multi gentiles, ut Xenophon, Herodotus, Iustinus, scriptis suis celebrarunt. Egregia appellatio, & admonens magistratus sui officij, qua Cyrus uocatur Pastor.
main_text.head: CAPUT XLV.
main_text.p: Sic dicit Dominus Mefchiæ suo Cho-refch: Cuius dexteram apprehendi, ut subijciam ante faciem eius gentes, &c lumbos regum diffoluam, aperiamq; ante faciem eius ostia, & portæ non claudentur. Ego ante te ibo, & uias obliquas rectas faciam, ostia ænea confringam, &c uectes[?] ferreos comminuam. Et dabo tibi thesauros in tenebris reconditos, & arcana quæq; latibulorū, ut scias quod ego sum Dominus Deus Israël, qui uoco nomé[?] tuum. Propter seruū meum Iacob, & Israël electū meum, uocabo te nomine tuo, cognominabo te, etiamsi non noueris me. Ego Dominus, &

page.notes: The italic runs in the commentary paragraph are judged from the scan and may be partly roman. "ueétes" is read as "uectes" with an uncertain accent mark. "nomé" carries a suspected abbreviation mark. "re-" hyphen is the printed line-end hyphen. The catchword "non" stands alone at lower right and is not repeated in the text.
